headline: New Jersey bill would ban Tesla's camera-only Robotaxi — lawmakers advancing legislation requiring driverless commercial vehicles to use cameras plus two additional sensor types (e.g., lidar + radar); Tesla's vision-only stack can't meet the mandate without a hardware redesign; sponsored by Sen. Andrew Zwicker ('This is not anti-Tesla — I'm pro-New Jersey safety'); Waymo's multi-sensor suite complies; NJ has no current Tesla robotaxi service and bill hasn't passed, but if enacted would block Tesla from operating commercially in one of the US's most densely populated states; signals camera-only bet is becoming a legislative target as robotaxi competition intensifies (Electrek / The Verge / InsideEVs, Jul 8–9, 2026)

Optimus Gen 3 design initially finalized — Musk sets hard supply chain targets: 1,000 units/week by September 2026, scaling to 2,000–2,500/week by year-end; full-year 2026 target 50,000–100,000 units; Fremont currently tracking 100–150 units/week in July, ~300/week in August; if EOY target achieved, Tesla becomes the first company to mass-produce a humanoid robot at automotive scale; supply chain constraints (actuators, structural composites) remain the primary execution risk for the Sept–Dec ramp (TradingKey / BigGo Finance, Jul 9–10, 2026)

Citizens Financial analyst: TSLA 2027–2028 revenue below consensus — Optimus investment cycle adds production complexity, delays, and elevated spending; firm initiated with Market Perform, flagging that current 200x+ forward earnings valuation prices in near-perfect execution; analyst explicitly cautious on pace of Optimus external sales ramp and robotaxi network effects materializing; TSLA stock slips overnight on the note; joins JPMorgan (Underweight/$145) as a voice of skepticism vs. predominantly bullish street (Stocktwits / Gurufocus, Jul 9–10, 2026)

UBS raises TSLA price target $364 → $442 (+21%), maintains Neutral — analyst Joseph Spak cites Tesla's long-term potential in physical AI and robotics as primary driver; UBS joins RBC ($500), Wedbush ($550+) in re-rating Tesla as an AI/robotics platform company rather than pure automaker; TSLA up ~3.4% Thursday to reclaim $405+ as Wall Street increasingly frames the Q2 delivery blowout (+25% YoY) through an AI lens ahead of Jul 22 earnings; consensus average PT now ~$424; UBS highlights Optimus production ramp (100–150 units/week in July, targeting 1,000/week by September) and robotaxi multi-city expansion as the two re-rating catalysts most likely to move the stock in H2 2026 (UBS / Yahoo Finance, Jul 9, 2026)

NHTSA closes 2022 investigation into ~695,000 Tesla Model 3 and Model Y vehicles for unexpected braking — no safety defect found; complaints dropped after software updates resolved the issue; second major NHTSA probe closure for Tesla in 2026, following the Jun 27 steering investigation closure; combined with NHTSA's Jun 29 brake pedal mandate removal and Texas Level 4 self-certification, Tesla's federal regulatory environment is materially improving ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings; NHTSA EA26002 (3.2M-vehicle FSD probe) remains the single primary open federal investigation (NHTSA / StocksToTrade, Jul 9, 2026)

Tesla FSD EU cascade reaches 4 markets — Germany live May 22, Denmark approved Jun 9, Belgium Jun 10; EU mutual recognition framework enables faster subsequent approvals without full country-by-country review; Tesla confirms FSD will also roll out to AI3-equipped European vehicles post-approval; EU Technical Committee next vote window July 2026 with 15/27 member states needed for bloc-wide harmonization; European Tesla registrations +107.9% YoY in May to 28,610 units and +57.2% YTD to 118,068 units (basenor / eleport.com, Jul 9, 2026)

Tesla FSD to gain voice-intent driving decisions — VP of AI Ashok Elluswamy confirms 'Working on it' for spoken contextual instructions like 'It's the white house on the left'; FSD would remember neighborhood-level preferences and translate spoken intent into driving decisions; marks key architectural step: Grok moves into a supervisor role feeding contextual intent directly into FSD's autonomous decision loop — consistent with the Digital Optimus thesis; feature in active development, no rollout timeline (Teslarati / notateslaapp, Jul 8–9, 2026)

Cybercab manufacturing breakthrough: Reaction Injection Molding (RIM) embeds color into panels during production — eliminates traditional paint shop entirely; Tesla confirmed RIM panels cut cycle times from hours to minutes; Tesla's 2025 Impact Report confirms RIM as one of Cybercab's core cost-reduction innovations alongside the Unboxed process; structural cost reduction directly supports Cybercab's sub-$40K unit economics target (Teslarati / Tesla 2025 Impact Report, Jul 7–8, 2026)

EXCLUSIVE: Production Cybercabs ship with enhanced FSD compute — >32GB RAM vs. consumer fleet's 32GB ceiling; likely AI4+ (64GB) or dual-AI4 config; gives Cybercab headroom to run next-gen neural networks (FSD v15+) without hardware retrofit; confirms Cybercab is hardware-differentiated from consumer Model 3/Y at launch (notateslaapp, Jul 7–8, 2026)

Tesla app 4.58.5 adds live 'Self-Driving' blue indicator — app now shows real-time FSD active status beneath speed readout; works across HW3/HW4; vehicle requires firmware 2026.20.6.1 (~49% fleet rollout as of Jul 7); critical for robotaxi fleet owners to monitor vehicle autonomy state remotely; app 4.58.6 adds new FSD state APIs (requires vehicle 2026.26+) for programmatic fleet monitoring — direct infrastructure for Cybercab fleet management at scale (notateslaapp / Teslarati, Jul 7–8, 2026)
